description: Builds a CV for the signed-in user from their public work and scores it out of 100. Software: built from the GitHub account (own public repositories; forks are not counted). Design: built from a Behance profile, a Dribbble profile and/or a portfolio site. Every CV line links to the page it came from and uses that page’s own words. The score has four parts: amount of real work (30), recency (25), depth (25) and fit to the field (20), with tips to improve. The report is private to the user, who can view or delete it at https://foundaree.com/cv.

domain.description: software (needs github) or design (needs at least one of behance, dribbble, portfolio).

name: build_cv
title: Build and score a CV from real work
